# Xiaomi Mijia MJBQDYJ1-WC Label Printer BLE Protocol

> Browser WebBluetooth label designer and reverse-engineered BLE protocol client for the Xiaomi Mijia MJBQDYJ1-WC 96-dot thermal label printer.

This site hosts a WebBluetooth label designer for the Xiaomi Mijia Label Printer model MJBQDYJ1-WC. The implementation is based on a reverse-engineered BLE protocol recovered from the macOS Xiaomi Home `xiaomi.printer.label` plugin.

Key protocol facts:

- BLE service: `0000FE95-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB`.
- Write characteristic: `0000001F-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB`.
- Notify characteristic: `00000020-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB`.
- Print raster: 96 dots wide, 1 bpp, MSB is the leftmost dot.
- Encrypted frame: `A3 20 <length LE16> <AES-128-CBC payload> <CRC32 LE>`.
- Plain notification frame: `A3 00 <length LE16> <plain body> <CRC32 LE>`.
- CRC32 uses custom seed `0x76953521`.

Repository and documentation:

- Project source: https://github.com/jasiek/xiaomi-mjbqdyj1-wc-reveng
- Detailed protocol notes: https://github.com/jasiek/xiaomi-mjbqdyj1-wc-reveng/blob/master/FINDINGS.md
- Live app: https://labelprinter.jasiek.me/
